title: Skip redundant packed-PCM staging

definition.title: Skip redundant packed-PCM staging
definition.source_excerpt: Question. Can admitted packed lossless integer audio be written directly into the existing FIFO, avoiding a temporary allocation and per-sample copy? The reviewed adaptation_frames allocates a converted AVFrame and copies sample/channel data before FIFO writing, including when data is already packed. S24 stored in S32 also requires validation that the low eight bits are zero. Planar interleaving and explicit Opus float conversion remain necessary in their respective paths. [D2] The native C prototype uses the real system libavutil FIFO API, but substitutes a malloc staging buffer for production AVFrame allocation. The packed candidate skips staging; S24 validates the entire input before publishing samples. Planar cases call the same baseline function as controls. FIFO write/read is retained, so this is not a zero-copy ownership claim. [F3]
